summary: Removed per-project .env copies in ncp and cronkis that had been duplicated instead of using a single shared file, and established ~/.env as the single shared source alongside the existing Windows user environment variable.
decisions: Single canonical .env lives at ~/.env (copied from gizmo/.env), not duplicated into each project's directory — per user request for one shared source rather than per-project copies.
Windows user environment variable TYPESAFE_API_KEY remains as the single shared runtime source of the secret across shells, verified via GetEnvironmentVariable.
errors: Assistant had previously copied gizmo/.env into ncp/.env and cronkis/.env instead of using a single shared file — corrected by deleting both copies and creating ~/.env instead.
